title: Genesis 15:1-3 — Abram's heir: Eliezer of Damascus, a servant in his household
summary: Genesis 15:1-3 quoted in English: God's word comes to Abram in a vision, and Abram, childless, says that Eliezer of Damascus, a servant in his household, will be his heir. Abram, Eliezer and servant are colour-highlighted.

text.text: 1 “After this, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”
2 But Abram said, “O Sovereign Lord, what can you give me since I remain childless and the one who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
3 And Abram said, “You have given me no children; so a servant in my household will be my heir.”

keywords: I am thy shield and thy exceeding great reward
